title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: next best actions from Customer Intent Agent in the Copilot pane
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents configuration APIs where the briefing says automation is not documented. Dataverse references expose writable next-best-action enablement and experience-profile Copilot settings. The roadmap facts and the cited administrative routes are supported.

claims.claim: Experience profiles control the groups of representatives who receive the enabled capabilities in Copilot Service workspace.
claims.quote:
To limit the Copilot features that specific representatives can use in Copilot Service workspace:

1. Create a custom experience profile and turn on only the required Copilot features.
2. Assign the custom experience profile to the representatives.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes suggesting knowledge articles to explain recommendations.
claims.quote: Knowledge articles are suggested so representatives can dig deeper and understand the reasoning behind the recommendations.

claims.claim: The roadmap lists drafting emails as a one-click action.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The next-best-action switch is at Copilot Service admin center > Support experience > Productivity > Intent-based suggestions > Manage > Turn on intent-based suggestions > Actions.
claims.quote: Select Productivity in Support experience. ... Select Manage for Intent-based suggestions. ... In the Turn on intent-based suggestions section ... Actions: Select to enable next best actions for cases, such as drafting emails or resolving the case.

claims.claim: Profile Copilot access is configured at Copilot Service admin center > Support experience > Workspaces > Experience profiles > profile > Productivity pane > Copilot.
claims.quote: go to Experience profiles in Support experience > Workspaces. ... Select the profile ... In the Productivity pane, select On ... Copilot ... Turn on the toggle next to each option in the Productivity pane to enable it for the service representative.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for enabling next best actions.
claims.quote: Update ... PATCH /msdyn_nextbestactionsconfigs(msdyn_nextbestactionsconfigid) ... msdyn_isenabled ... Whether Next Best Actions is enabled for this target entity.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api null with kind 'rest', call 'PATCH /msdyn_nextbestactionsconfigs(msdyn_nextbestactionsconfigid)', and docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/developer/reference/entities/msdyn_nextbestactionsconfig'. Add to its note: 'The request body sets msdyn_isenabled; msdyn_targetentity identifies the target entity, such as incident. This operation documents next-best-action enablement, not experience-profile assignment.' Replace the blanket no-API sentence with 'Dataverse documents updates to next-best-action enablement and profile Copilot configuration.' Cite both Dataverse references used for the API corrections.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for experience-profile Copilot access settings.
claims.quote: Update ... PATCH /msdyn_appcopilotconfigurations(msdyn_appcopilotconfigurationid) ... msdyn_appconfigurationid ... App profile ... msdyn_copilotfeature ... Copilot Feature ... msdyn_enabled ... Enabled
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].api null with kind 'rest', call 'PATCH /msdyn_appcopilotconfigurations(msdyn_appcopilotconfigurationid)', and docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/developer/reference/entities/msdyn_appcopilotconfiguration'. Add to the note: 'For individual profile Copilot features, the request body sets msdyn_enabled; msdyn_copilotfeature identifies the feature and msdyn_appconfigurationid links the app profile.' Cite this reference and https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/guidance/resources/cs-contact-center-copilot-setup#copilot-settings-in-agent-profiles, which identifies the underlying table for profile Copilot settings. Remove the blanket no-API claim.

claims.claim: Turning off intent-based suggestions or removing them from a profile does not revert Copilot or other shared settings.
claims.quote: If you turn off intent-based suggestion or remove it from an experience profile, it doesn't revert the Copilot or other shared settings.

claims.quote: The Basic User role, which is required to create profiles in Copilot Service admin center.

claims.claim: System Administrator is a prerequisite for setting up Copilot features.
claims.quote:
Before you set up Copilot features, ensure that you:

- Have the System Administrator role.

claims.claim: By default, only users with the Customer Service Representative role can use Copilot features.
claims.quote: By default, only users with the Customer Service Representative role can use Copilot features.

claims.claim: Representatives added to default experience profiles can use Copilot features by default.
claims.quote: By default, representatives you add to the default experience profiles can use Copilot features.

claims.quote: Check with finance whether the pay-as-you-go plan ... is in place ... Check that custom security roles carry the Copilot privileges ... Check the environment's geography against the data movement rules
